title.full: Reporting a death that occurred overseas

summary.text: Register the death overseas, get a death certificate, then report it to ICA.

steps.name: Register the death
steps.text: If the person was a Singapore citizen or permanent resident, register the death with the foreign authorities in the country where they passed away.

items: If the person was a Singapore citizen or permanent resident, register the death with the foreign authorities in the country where they passed away.

steps.name: Get the death certificate
steps.text: Get a death certificate from the foreign authorities in the country where the person passed away.

items: Get a death certificate from the foreign authorities in the country where the person passed away.

steps.name: Report the death to ICA
steps.text: Report the death to ICA with the foreign death certificate, so ICA can update its records.

items: Report the death to ICA with the foreign death certificate, so ICA can update its records.

sources.page_title: How do I report death that occurred overseas?

quotes.text: If a Singapore citizen or permanent resident had passed on overseas, you should register the death and get a death certificate from the foreign authorities in the country where the person had passed on.
get a death certificate from the foreign authorities in the country where the person had passed on
You can then report the death to ICA with the foreign death certificate to update ICA's records.
